bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
has_cursor="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_poll_cursor WHERE consumer_id=\x27createvdobot\x27"' 2>/dev/null || true)"
test "$has_cursor" = 1 || exit 72
recent_cursor="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_poll_cursor WHERE consumer_id=\x27createvdobot\x27 AND updated_at>NOW()-INTERVAL \x2724 hours\x27"' 2>/dev/null || true)"
test "$recent_cursor" = 1 || exit 73
pending="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_webhook_updates WHERE status=\x27needs_reconcile\x27 AND updated_at>NOW()-INTERVAL \x277 days\x27"' 2>/dev/null || true)"
test "$pending" = 0 || exit 74
exit 0
